description: Machine-readable form of contracts/host-port.md. Internal contract between the Orbit core and a host adapter. Not a Loom dependency; Loom depends on contracts/integration.md only. Within one major version methods and optional fields are only added, never changed or removed.

result.note: cwd is absolute; other fields are adapter-private

items.note: id is stable; other fields are adapter-private

definitions.H1: See user message and stable id before the first model request; may attach guidance or abort. Missing: disable automatic entry, keep explicit start only.
definitions.H2: Project effective requirements on every request and inject a state summary per turn. Missing: cannot host a controlled task.
definitions.H3: Intercept before tool calls: members cannot delegate, path and command scope, model authorization. Missing: cannot host a controlled task.
definitions.H4: Register a member before its first model call; abort on failure. Missing: cannot host a controlled task.
definitions.H5: Stop and confirm: idle, no in-flight tool, owned background work finished, task messages cleared from the queue. Missing: cannot host a controlled task.
definitions.H6: Receipts for every model and tool call: actual model, usage, time. Missing: strict model authorization and ledger are invalid.
definitions.H7: Isolated read-only checker session: separate process, read-only tools, fixed snapshot. Missing: cannot host a controlled task.
definitions.O1: Members exchange messages. Missing: disable that collaboration, Root only.
definitions.O2: Forward user amendments to active members. Missing: send to Root only, record as undelivered.
definitions.O3: Skipped native question tracking and follow-up reminders. Missing: no follow-up reminder.
definitions.O4: Inject cooperation policy at the same layer as system instructions. Missing: carry it through H2 projection.

conformance.gate: A host must pass conformance before it can host a controlled task.
conformance.upgrade: Re-run on every host version bump instead of per-version manual review.
